summary: The first T-029 campaign-audit implementation slice correctly stayed read-only and, after one bounded replay, reconstructed parent campaigns through closeout episodes and child run-ledger sessions. It still failed final acceptance because completion reason, vision band or score, recommendation confidence, evaluator scores, UX Anchor Scorecards, verification commands, and deterministic child ordering were not yet explicit in the report schema.
evidence: S4 evaluator initially failed the direct-run-only implementation. The bounded replay fixed parent loop reconstruction and dogfood against autonomous-auto-campaign-evaluation-learning-closure-20260425 found four child scopes with repo-native stage and evaluator evidence. Final evaluator score was 0.82 but disposition remained fail because T-029 acceptance still requires richer completion, vision, confidence, evaluator, UX, verification, and ordering fields. Replay threshold was already used, so the campaign stopped without marking T-029 complete.
recommended_action: Open a fresh T-029 follow-up campaign to complete the report schema: derive completion reason and vision evidence from closeout or loop state when present, add recommendation confidence, extract evaluator scores and UX Anchor Scorecards when available, surface verification commands, and order child scopes by loop_iteration or timestamp rather than session-id lexicography. Keep the command read-only and retain the parent-loop reconstruction tests.
